title: Feature catalog registry (features/registry.json, D12)
description: Producer: features/registry.py::generate_registry_json/upload_registry, a serialization of CATALOG (list[FeatureEntry]), written by D31 (and retired D12) on every non-dry run. Consumer: crucible-dashboard views/13_Feature_Store.py::_load_registry (data-collector plan P-07, alpha-engine-config-I10870, D12). This schema covers ONLY the S3-published registry.json artifact. The per-COLUMN contract for features/{date}/*.parquet is contracts/features_parquet.schema.json, generated from the same CATALOG (alpha-engine-config-I10793), which also carries the parquet keys' x-key-pattern and x-settling-bar.
